h1: Custom Tri Blend Shirts for Bulk Orders
metaTitle: Custom Tri Blend Shirts | Perfect Imprints
metaDescription: Order custom tri blend shirts in bulk at Perfect Imprints. Soft, durable fabric perfect for your brand.
introHtml: Tri blend shirts combine cotton, polyester, and rayon for a fabric that feels broken-in from day one. This blend offers the breathability of cotton, the durability of polyester, and the drape of rayon, making it ideal for company uniforms, event giveaways, or team apparel. Unlike standard cotton tees, tri blend shirts resist shrinking and fading while maintaining a soft hand feel. Decorate with screen printing or embroidery for a polished, long-lasting look that employees and customers will actually want to wear.
heroAltText: Stack of custom tri blend shirts in various colors with company logos printed on the front
